# `features/table`

A table needs columns, sorting, selection, cell renderers and a toolbar.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A table needs columns, sorting, selection, cell renderers and a toolbar.
- **Avoid when:** The dataset needs several saved views, or you are writing table markup directly.
- **Consider instead:** `features/data-view`, `base/table`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { AvatarCell } from "themelia-ui/features/table"
import "themelia-ui/features/table.css"
```

## Optional peers

Install these only when importing this family:

```bash
npm install @tanstack/react-table
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/action-menu`, `base/avatar`, `base/badge`, `base/batch-action-bar`, `base/buttons`, `base/choice-inputs`, `base/display`, `base/feedback`, `base/navigation`, `base/table`, `base/text-inputs`, `base/toolbar`, `base/typography`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

### `DataTable`

Kind: callable.

**Use when:** A typed table with column, sorting and selection controls.

**Avoid when:** Needing a complete resource browser with saved views and filters.

Kind: interface.

A row action: the kit's `ContextAction`, bound to the row. `onClick`, `visible` and
`disabled` receive the row; everything else is an `ActionDefinition` field.

Extends: `ContextAction<TData>`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `label` | yes | `string` |  |
| `href` | no | `string` | Carried as data; the table never navigates. Route with your own router in `onClick`. |

### `useDataTableScrollState`

Kind: callable.

```text
(tableAreaRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>, options?: { stepPx?: number; deps?: readonly unknown[]; }) => UseDataTableScrollStateResult
```

### `UseDataTableScrollStateResult`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `canScrollLeft` | yes | `boolean` |  |
| `canScrollRight` | yes | `boolean` |  |
| `scrollBy` | yes | `(delta: number) => void` |  |
| `scrollLeft` | yes | `() => void` |  |
| `scrollRight` | yes | `() => void` |  |

### `useDataTableSize`

Kind: callable.

```text
() => DataTableSize
```

### `useFullscreenTableModality`

Kind: callable.

```text
(active: boolean, regionRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, onExit: () => void) => void
```

## Preview recipes

Preview route: Data view & data table — `/data-view`

### What the data view decides

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<DataTable
  columns={columns}
  data={bookings}
  enableSorting
  enableRowSelection
  enableColumnVisibility
  stickyFirstColumn
  getRowId={(row) => row.id}
  rowActions={(row) => [
    { id: "open", label: "Open", onClick: () => navigate(row.id) },
    { id: "archive", label: "Archive", tone: "destructive", onClick: () => archive(row) },
  ]}
/>
```

### Cells

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
cell: ({ row }) => (
  <CellStack values={[
    row.customer,
    [row.customerEmail, "email"],
    row.vip && { value: "VIP", kind: "mono" },
  ]} />
)
```

### Acting on a selection

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<DataTable
  enableRowSelection
  initialState={{ rowSelection: { b2: true, b4: true } }}
  bulkActions={({ selectedRowCount, clearSelection }) => (
    <Button onClick={() => archive(selectedRowCount)}>Archive selected</Button>
  )}
/>
```
